newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Hung Kai & Co 1996 net up 1.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hung Kai & Co 1996 net up 1.7 pct.

text.p: Year ended December 31
(in million HK$ unless stated)
Shr (H.K. cents) 29.0 vs 29.4 (adjusted)
Dividend (H.K. cents) 5.0 vs 15.0
Exceptional items 18.13 loss vs 11.33 gain
Net 214.72 vs 211.08 (see note)
Turnover 653.31 vs 646.70
Company name Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd
Books close June 16-20
Dividend payable June 27
NOTE - Sun Hung Kai & Co is a financial services and brokerage firm.
Net is after an exceptional loss on deemed disposal of a listed associated company following dilution in shareholding as a result of share issue not taken up.
The calculation of share earnings is based on the weighted average of 739.24 million shares vs 718.40 million shares after adjusting for a rights issue during the year.
Total dividend for the year is seven H.K. cents (including an interim dividend of two cents) vs 18 cents.
Durning the year, a listed associated company changed its accounting policy in respect of recognition of income from sale of development properties.

Previously, income from the pre-sale of properties in the course of construction was recognised over the entire period of construction to reflect the progress of the development and was computed as a proportion of the sale consideration.
Profit recognised on this basis was limited to the amount of non-refundable sales deposits received.

With effect from the current year, income arising from the sale of development property is recognised upon the execution of a binding sales agreement or the issuance of completion certificates by the relevant government authorities, whichever is the later.

Such change of accounting policy has resulted in a reduction in the group's previously reported share of profit before taxation and taxation charges for the year ended December 31, 1995, by HK$3.95 million and HK$2.37 million respectively, and a reduction in the group's share of retained profit at December 31, 1995 by HK$18 million. Comparative figures for 1995 have been restated to take into account the change.
